newsitem.title: USA: Maine corrections union says approves new contract.
newsitem.headline: Maine corrections union says approves new contract.

text.p: The 1,200-member union of state corrections and mental health workers said it approved a new contract with the state, which calls for a one-time lump sum payment of two-and-a-quarter percent of annual pay. Council Director Bob Basso for the American Federation of State, County and Municipal Employees said the contract, which starts in January, includes base salary increases of two percent each year beginning in July. He added a key aspect of the pact was a provision giving corrections officers back an hour-and-a-half of their weekly work week, which was subtracted by the state as a cost-cutting measure. The state legislature still must give the contract final funding approval. --U.S. Municipal Desk, 212-859-1650
